I'll tell him. How was your shift covering at the clinic billing desk Friday?

Good. Also I told her inside table, not that side patio. Last time your jacket carried that whole outside cloud home.
Thank you. Inside by the wall is perfect.
Saturday walk from the King Park gazebo, 11am sharp. Family-friendly, signs only, organizers said route ends by 12:30.
I'm in. One walk, then home. I can drop $25 into the community bond pool too, that's what I have right now.

I left my badge in your car last night. Of course I noticed five minutes before report.
I can swing it by the staff entrance at 9:20. I already put your water bottle in my tote too.
You stay keeping us alive in little ways. Tasha said the quartet was worth her missing bedtime.
Tell her I have the receipt and her leftovers. Next month we pick somewhere with parking that does not test my spirit.
Between rooms but I looked at what you sent. The county page and the hospital sheet say the same thing.
Good. I had my card updated Wednesday and just wanted to make sure I followed the timing right.
Yep. Hydrate, move that arm, and do not let somebody's loud cousin group chat override actual nurses.
You know I came to you before answering anybody in that thread.
Did maintenance ever come back for that bathroom fan?
They left a tag on my door. I have to call the office Monday because nobody was there to let them in.
Ask for a morning slot and keep the chain on until you see the badge.
I will. I already paid the service fee through the portal, so I just need the fan fixed.
You still coming to coffee at 9, or did the floor-and-breath timer run long again?

Good. Keep the low horn record energy and do not arrive with a spreadsheet for brunch.
No promises on the spreadsheet. The record is still barely playing, though.
You moved those Friday people without turning the whole calendar upside down, right?

I know. The cancellation this morning helped the schedule, just not the deposit.
You already out there by the river? I drove past Fall Creek and thought that looked like your jacket.

Say less. I can cover snacks if you already set aside that dentist money.

You still coming to Mom's after church tomorrow?

Drawer sounds right. Bring it tomorrow if you need another set of eyes. No 11pm math.
Deal. I wrote the three actual numbers down and I'm doing the breathing card before bed.
Did that J&L Auto charge clear yet, or are they still holding part of it?
It cleared. That one line is why February looks ugly next to my normal sheet.
Keep your receipt. If the same warning light comes back, they need to look at it without charging you again.
I kept it. I can handle one more $400-ish surprise if I have to, but I really do not want to pull that lever.
Good morning. If you come by after church, please use Central instead of that side street. The light near the laundromat was out again last night.
I saw that. I am testing the longer block by the library this week, especially if I am carrying my little daypack.
That sounds more sensible. Bring me the map you printed with those red-rock places too, I want to see where you keep circling.
I will. I also wrote down what the Eagle Creek folks said about shoes that dry fast.
Baby I found your school picture from when we lived over on 38th & Keystone. You were maybe 7. Marcus is all chubby cheeks.
Lol send it!! That apartment was tiny. Same school I walked to in middle school too right
Yes same one all the way through. You never left this side of town til you started traveling for that conference work.
True. Indy raised me. Bring the picture Sunday, I want to scan it
Are you coming after church or are you still doing your Sunday pans?
After I get the greens washed and the grain started. I can bring you two containers if you want.
That would help. Please do not forget to move those little plants before the cold air hits the window tonight.
Already shifted them in from the glass. I will stop by around 2:30.
Baby, Sister Pearl shared that flyer you made for the spring cookout on her page. It looks beautiful. The whole prayer circle saw it.
Aw I'm glad! That's the one I put up Friday with the church group tagged. The other page is mostly clients so I keep cookout stuff off there.
Pastor's wife asked if you could put the bake sale on there too. She doesn't do the other one.
Yes ma'am, I'll add it tonight on the same page as the cookout. Easier for her to find.
You still up looking at that car estimate?
I opened it twice and now my jaw feels locked. Closing the laptop before I start adding every possible mistake I made this month.
Put it away. Send it to me tomorrow and I will tell you what actually needs doing.
Deal. I am putting the phone across the room too, because one look at the feed and I will be awake till 2.

Thank you. I already put a repair ceiling in the car tab before the Kia draft comes out Friday.
Good. Keep the receipt and compare it against the estimate, not what they say at the counter.
I will. The app has the shop category yelling at me, so I moved Friday's product order down one row.

Eight years in March. Tell her bring the discharge paper, I'll work the scapula slow and check the fascia around the rotator.

Done. I am also adding a line that the class pairs home routines with keeping regular appointments.

Auntie Raki the saint. Kids been asking when you coming over for Sunday dinner again
Tell them next Sunday after I bring Mama home. I'll come straight from picking her up.

lol you and your shame researchers

already pulled a little earlier this month, putting it back from the Saturday bookings. running a 2-for-1 gift card thing this week too

Better. Keep the wrap in your bag and stop stacking all the grip-heavy work together.

wrist still talking to you? saw you grinding all weekend
ran 24 on the table this week 😩 sliding two off next week so I can ease it

ik. plan is always 22-26. just picked up two when Lena went out. helps me push past a slow stretch too

girl Monique wants to do Tuesday dinner at Maxine's. you in?

My shift ate me alive. Are we still doing noodles, or are you folded up on that mat already?

Take the five. Put on that old sax record you like and come human.
Already on, low enough for the neighbors not to learn my whole evening.

Im in. I want them to hear about the cases where somebody in crisis didnt need a cruiser, they needed somebody trained.
